name: Meeting
agenda_text:
SPECIAL MEETING
OF THE CITY COUNCIL
AND THE CITY COUNCIL AS THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - MAY 10, 2012 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation The California Court of Appeal has concluded that sectarian prayer as part of the City Council meetings is not permitted under the Constitution.
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call Council/Agency Member Carol Chen
Council/Agency Member Joseph Cho, Ph.D.
Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Bruce Barrows
Mayor/Chair Jim Edwards
5.
Presentations PLEASE NOTE: Staff reports are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions Those wishing to present comments on other than Agenda items are requested to complete and submit a blue Speaker’s Card. The Public Comments and Suggestions portion of the meeting will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested to state their name and city of residence for the record.
7.
Consideration of appointments to vacancies on various commissions, boards and committees
A.
Consideration of nomination of a private sector representative to the Board of Directors of the Southeast Los Angeles County Workforce Investment Board (SELACO WIB). (COUNCIL)
CONSENT CALENDAR
Items 8, 9, 10 and 11 under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
8.
Approval of Registers of Demands
A.
City of Cerritos dated May 10, 2012. (COUNCIL)
approve the Register of Demands dated May 10, 2012, checks 133382 through 133619, in the total amount of $11,943,700.50.
B.
Successor Agency dated May 10, 2012. (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the Register of Demands dated May 10, 2012, checks 903947 through 903951, in the total amount of $4,302,832.46.
9.
Approval of Minutes
A.
City Council Special Meeting of April 23, 2012. (COUNCIL)
approve the City Council Special Meeting Minutes of April 23, 2012.
B.
Successor Agency Special Meeting of April 23, 2012. (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
approve the Successor Agency Special Meeting Minutes of April 23, 2012.
10.
Ordinance for second reading and adoption. Reading of ordinance waived at introduction.
A.
ORDINANCE NO. 969 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING THE CERRITOS DEVELOPMENT MAP BY CHANGING THE ZONE CLASSIFICATION OF APPROXIMATELY ±2.21 ACRES OF LAND, LOCATED AT 19033 STUDEBAKER ROAD, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA 90703 (APN 7049-014-907), FROM REGIONAL COMMERICAL (CR) TO OPEN SPACE (OS). (COUNCIL)
waive reading of and adopt Ordinance No. 969 entitled: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING THE CERRITOS DEVELOPMENT MAP BY CHANGING THE ZONE CLASSIFICATION OF APPROXIMATELY ±2.21 ACRES OF LAND, LOCATED AT 19033 STUDEBAKER ROAD, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA 90703 (APN 7049-014-907), FROM REGIONAL COMMERCIAL (CR) TO OPEN SPACE (OS).
11.
Miscellaneous
A.
Review and consideration of an agreement for advance and reimbursement of expenses for office space, equipment and supplies by and between the City of Cerritos and the Successor Agency to the City of Cerritos Redevelopment Agency. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
recommend that the Cerritos City Council approve the attached agreement for advance and reimbursement of expenses for office space, equipment and supplies by and between the City of Cerritos and the Successor Agency to the City of Cerritos Redevelopment Agency.
recommend that the Successor Agency Board approve the attached agreement for advance and reimbursement of expenses for office space, equipment and supplies by and between the City of Cerritos and the Successor Agency to the City of Cerritos Redevelopment Agency.
End of Consent Calendar
If you would like to speak on any of the remaining Agenda items, please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card. Speakers will be called upon for comment after the report on the item is given by City staff.
12.
Public Works Activities
A.
Consideration and approval of a Memorandum of Agreement with the Los Angeles Gateway Region Integrated Regional Water Management Joint Powers Authority for the administration and cost sharing of regional compliance efforts with the total maximum daily loads for metals and selenium in the San Gabriel River and impaired tributaries. (COUNCIL)
enter into the attached Memorandum of Agreement with the Los Angeles Gateway Region Integrated Regional Water Management Joint Powers Authority for implementation of the Total Maximum Daily Load for Metals and Selenium for the San Gabriel River and Impaired Tributaries.
B.
Consideration and award of contract to conduct an evaluation of current street conditions and update the Cerritos Pavement Management System. (COUNCIL)
recommend that the Cerritos City Council:
1. Find that contracting with Infrastructure Management Services is in the best interest of the City, that dispensing with the bidding process satisfies the purposes of the purchasing ordinance of the Cerritos Municipal Code, and that it is reasonable and necessary to sole source the PMS update; and
2. Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract with Infrastructure Management Services for the proposed services in the amount of $56,000.
C.
Consideration and approval of a change order to add portions of 166th Street to the contract with Sequel Contractors for the Construction of Street Improvements in Residential Streets, Project No. 14088-12, Bid No. 1139-12. (COUNCIL)
recommend that City Council:
1. Approve a change order to add portions of 166th Street to the contract with Sequel Contractors for the Construction of Street Improvement in Residential Streets, Project No. 14088-12, Bid No. 1139-12; and
2. Authorize the expenditure of $116,825 in STP-L exchange funds to complete the increased scope of work.
D.
Consideration of a participation with the City of La Palma in a shared jurisdiction street improvement project on Carmenita Road/Moody Street between Coyote Creek and Jewel Court/Houston Avenue. (COUNCIL)
recommend that the Cerritos City Council:
1. Authorize participation of the City of Cerritos with the City of La Palma in a shared jurisdiction street improvement project on Carmenita Road/Moody Street between Coyote Creek and Jewel Court/Houston Street; and
2. Authorize the use of $79,000 in funds from the fiscal year 2011-2012 Cerritos Combined Financial Program Street Maintenance Fund; and
3. Authorize the City Manager to approve and execute the associated project participation agreement with the City of La Palma.
13.
Pending Legal Matters
A.
Consideration to waive reading of and introduce AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER 2.16 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE TO CHANGE THE REGULAR CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING FREQUENCY FROM TWO MEETINGS PER MONTH TO ONE MEETING PER MONTH WITH A SECOND MONTHLY MEETING ADDED ON AN AS-NEEDED BASIS. (COUNCIL)
recommend that the City Council:
1. Make the findings set forth in the Cerritos Planning Commission Resolution No. PC 2012-18; and
2. Waive reading of and introduce an ordinance amending Chapter 2.16, Planning Commission, of the Cerritos Municipal Code, captioned: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER 2.16 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE TO CHANGE THE REGULAR CERRITOS PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING FREQUENCY FROM TWO MEETINGS PER MONTH TO ONE MEETING PER MONTH WITH A SECOND MONTHLY MEETING ADDED ON AN AS-NEEDED BASIS.
14.
New and Old Business
A.
Review and consideration of a program for the temporary installation of sculptures in the Cerritos Sculpture Garden-generally located in the Cerritos Civic Center on the northwest corner of Bloomfield Avenue and 183rd Street, west of the Cerritos Sheriff’s Station (APN 7025-028-904). (COUNCIL)
recommend that the City Council review and approve:
1. The program for the construction of the permanent concrete pads for the temporary installation of sculptures for the Cerritos Sculpture Garden;
2. Appropriate an amount of $30,000 for the initial program from the Art in Public Places Trust Fund to construct the permanent concrete pads and provide for the costs associated with implementing this program.
15.
Report on Pending Legislation
A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the California Legislature or pending in the California Governor’s Office for signature.
16.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.
17.
Adjournment
